---
name: risk-prediction
description: Predict technical outcomes, costs and risks with explicit assumptions and confidence.
agent: architect
---

Assess proposed architecture and requirements. Build a risk register with likelihood, impact, confidence, leading indicators, mitigations and evidence needed.

Include: video size/duration, GPU/VRAM, local vs hosted inference, multimodal sampling, transcription/alignment, gaming scene density, render throughput, object storage, external API quotas, OAuth/app review, publishing idempotency, costs, third-party licences and AGPL concerns.

Predictions must distinguish measured facts from assumptions. Do not invent throughput, costs or success rates. Define a benchmark plan for representative podcast, education, gaming and comedy videos. No implementation. Finish `NEEDS APPROVAL`.
